title: Original kin-hall and season-court culture
scope: Qualitative frame of the region's original locally rooted pre-imperial culture — kin-hall social unit, season-court federation, spoken-precedent law and speaker class, virtues and shames, faith orientation, dress marker classes, System folk tradition, and survival mode under the empire; usable for culture and background development without establishing in-world names, speech content, rite content, exchange media, imperial instruments, founding claims, settlement-present cultural relations, demography, or any change to natural System behaviour.
claims: The original culture predates the empire in the region and survived the imperial period folded — carried inside households and customs — not erased.
Its social unit is the extended kin-hall: linked households of one recognised descent web, and a person without a hall is a person in danger.

Halls federate through season-courts — recurring assemblies at fixed customary places, keyed to the seasonal rhythms, where law is spoken, disputes are heard, marriages and fosterings are arranged, and goods are exchanged.
Its law is customary precedent recited by a memory-trained speaker class raised by memory-line apprenticeship: authoritative in standing, fallible in fact, and openly arguable at court.

Its leadership classes are hall-elders, court-ground hosting lineages, and the speaker class; status runs from full hall-members through dependents and fostered outsiders to the hall-less, whose protection is a court obligation and a live moral test.

Its virtues are hall-hospitality (the guest eats first), true recall (precedent spoken whole, against interest if need be), season-duty, and refuge-duty — the height denied to none who flee; its shames are hall-betrayal, false recall, refusing refuge, and waste of common stores.

The virtues genuinely grind against one another — hospitality against stores-prudence, true recall against hall loyalty — an old, unresolved argument settled differently by hall, and their cost is real and unevenly borne: hall-hospitality and refuge-duty are paid out of common stores by people who did not choose the guest, and hall standing leaves dependents and the hall-less genuinely exposed; neither list renders the culture simply good or bad.

The fortified height is this culture's communal work: refuge in danger, highest court ground in peace, wall and law one inheritance; a pre-imperial fortified-height tradition is originated here as this culture's own background and as a tradition class only, and whether any later settlement's fortification revives it is available resonance for WLD-CULTURE-005, which owns founding claims, and is not claimed here.

Its faith orientation reveres three classes, as contested belief only: ancestors as the source of precedent, imagined still attentive to their halls; land-and-season powers propitiated at year-turns and courts; and the System, read as the world's impartial order, the one witness that never misremembers.

That System reading is folk interpretation and nothing more: no System channel bears on testimony or recollection, attests truth, verifies precedent, or is available as court evidence, the never-misremembering reading is often wrong, and sceptics within the culture say so.

Its dress is layered material classes — a woven fibre-cloth body layer, a working over-layer, and a heavy felted or hide-class outer — with a woven edge-pattern on the outer layer as the belonging-marker class marking hall and descent web, and worked hard-material fasteners, plain to fine, as the status-marker class.

Its System folk practice follows WLD-CULTURE-001's practice layers — everyday use in court-and-witness framing, advantage hoarded as hall property, a thin specialist tradition inside the speaker class, and abundant folk belief, often wrong, reading interface impressions as ancestral or seasonal favour — all of it cultural layering over unchanged natural System behaviour.

Under the empire, the season-courts were the part displaced and partly used: the judgement the courts had carried passed away from them to the imperial frame's own arrangement and continued only so far as a recognition extended from outside the culture covered it, and gatherings the empire found convenient were turned to its own uses.

Hall lines went two ways and survived either way: some kept a recognised public standing under the imperial frame, held on that frame's terms and withdrawable at its pleasure, which the more ambitious lines sought and paid for and their neighbours judged variously; others folded inward — precedent-speaking as household memory-keeping, hall marks as family weave, refuge-duty as quiet custom.
The heights lapsed mainly through disuse under imperial presence and its organised ecological suppression; any active discouragement is remembered differently and remains open.
The culture is internally varied — by district, descent line, and household — never uniform; no claim holds for every line, and its members disagree about their own tradition.
Its speech variety exists and its lifecycle rites exist; neither's content is established here.

It contributes to the settlement's braid, most visibly within the locally-rooted strand class, but equals no strand exclusively; its people and part-descendants appear across strand classes, and WLD-CULTURE-001's fabric is unchanged.

All faith content in this record is belief, interpretation, and presentation only: no deity, cosmology, afterlife, ancestor presence, or System character is confirmed, and natural System behaviour is unchanged.
boundaries: This record is a forward culture extension filling the capture's declared-open human-cultures space and the three-culture frame's original slot; it moves no accepted claim and narrows no other record's declared-open question beyond the declared closures stated here.

Kin-hall, season-court, descent web, speaker class, hall-elder, court ground, hall-less, virtue, shame, marker class, and every other label are author-facing qualitative descriptions; they fix no in-world name, word, title, place, calendar, procedure, office, law text, measurement, proportion, rite content, linguistic fact, or performance guarantee.
No in-world name, deity, self-designation, speech content, vocabulary, phonology, or script is established; all such content remains a protected unknown.

The culture's lifecycle rites exist with zero content here; ceremony form, timing, officiant, meaning, and whether any threshold is marked by rite at all belong wholly to canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/lifecycle-threshold-witness-rites, no rite in this record triggers, gates, modifies, or guarantees any System event, and natural-law awakening is untouched (CAL0 WLD1.0D unapplied).

The culture's speech variety is declared to exist with zero content; canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/generational-language-landscape owns every sociolinguistic question, and no vocabulary, phonology, script, register, or speech fact follows from anything here.

Court exchange and common stores are stated without medium, unit, price, rate, share, or accounting method; canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/dual-sphere-exchange-media owns every monetary question.

Imperial action appears at function level only — adjudication displaced and continuing only under an outside recognition, convenient gatherings turned to imperial use, some hall lines holding a recognised public standing on the imperial frame's own terms while others folded inward, heights lapsing largely through disuse; the concrete instrument by which judgement passed, gatherings were turned, and any standing was recognised, sought, or paid for is established by canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/imperial-charter-and-guild-culture alone, this record asserts no imperial registration, enumeration, count, roll, ladder, office, grant, body, or term of any kind, and the option-local instrument sketches retained in the promoted proposal are nonbinding decision evidence.

The survival mode describes the imperial period in the region; it makes no claim about the settlement's present cultural relations, and nothing here makes the original culture suppressed, subordinate, or marginal at the settlement.

Refuge-duty is the virtue under which the settlement's founding admissions read as this culture's own highest obligation, and that resonance is noted only; every founding claim — the founder's origin, the admission of imperial refugees, and the settlement's present cultural relations — is owned by canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/settlement-founding-fusion-blend, and this record neither establishes nor closes any of them.

Declared origination, narrowly bounded: the pre-imperial fortified-height tradition is originated by this record as this culture's own background and by no other record; WLD-HISTORY-001 carries no such claim and gains none from it, heights are a tradition class and not identified places, sites, works, or any settlement's fortification, no date, phase, count, construction, siting, or infrastructure origin follows, and whether any present settlement's fortification revives the tradition belongs wholly to canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/settlement-founding-fusion-blend with WLD-LOCATION-001, being available resonance only here.

Declared qualitative closure of WLD-CULTURE-001's open faith-content space, for this culture only: a faith orientation exists at the level of which classes of thing are revered and how the System is read; all observance content, shrine and practitioner classes, prayer, offering, doctrine, and their accuracy remain open, no faith claim here is confirmed metaphysics, and belief about ancestors and the dead settles no cosmology, afterlife, or Soul question (CAL0 RES0.10D).

Declared qualitative closure of WLD-CULTURE-001's open clothing space, for this culture only: dress is layered functional material classes carrying one belonging-marker class and one status-marker class; no organism, fibre, technique, garment form, colour, decoration, or manufacture is established, and all of those, and all settlement dress, remain open.

Declared qualitative closure of WLD-CULTURE-001's open festival-observance space, for this culture only: this culture's own assemblies are keyed to seasonal rhythms and carry observance — year-turn and court propitiation; calendar, dates, season names, cadence, and all observance content remain open, as do the settlement's festivals in every respect.

Declared qualitative closure of WLD-CULTURE-001's open store-accounting and exchange space, for this culture only: common stores and court exchange exist as institutions of this culture; medium, unit, price, rate, share, accounting method, rationing, and allocation authority remain open, and WLD-ECOLOGY-006's harvest-institution boundary stands untouched, with every harvest technique, rule, ownership, preservation method, and shore institution open.

Non-transfer: nothing here establishes any present-day settlement household's or strand's dress, faith, festival, observance, store, or exchange content; all of it remains WLD-CULTURE-001's open space, the locally-rooted strand class gains no fixed content, no strand is or becomes this culture, and every strand class stays open as a protagonist origin.

WLD-CULTURE-002 is untouched: no compact claim is made, the assembly-habit and spoken-precedent resemblance is available resonance only, no descent of the compact from this culture is claimed, and the compact's origins, terms, office classes, ambiguity classes, and every question it leaves open stand exactly as accepted.

WLD-HISTORY-001 remains the sole chronology and imperial-period authority; this record adds no phase, date, cause, or event, imperial-period memory here is divided and fallible and never evidence of what occurred, the heights' lapse is attributed only to imperial presence and the organised ecological suppression that record already establishes, no regional peace, security, or disarmament condition is claimed, and what that suppression consisted of stays open.

No specific settlement, site, map, route, or work is claimed under WLD-LOCATION-001, WLD-LOCATION-004, or WLD-LOCATION-005; heights are a tradition class, not identified places, and remnant recognition stays cultural recognition per WLD-LOCATION-004.

Material classes only, under WLD-ECOLOGY-005 and the WLD-FAUNA-001 and WLD-FLORA-004 rosters: no organism, lineage, kingdom, fibre source, human use, or import is established, and all life referenced is local.
No quantitative demography, proportion, price, measurement, or date finer than the accepted shared anchors is established.

The frame is author-side cultural truth; a character knows precedent, another hall's custom, or the imperial-period past only through an available source — memory, speaker, mark, or instruction — and every such source is fallible.

Divided imperial memory, quiet custom continuity, and contestable tradition claims are standing texture at story start, not occurred events; no incident, dispute, court sitting, occurrence, protagonist fact, or character fact is established.

Every faith, ancestor, and System-reading claim sits on the records, access, belief, interpretation, or presentation layer over unchanged natural System behaviour (CAL0 UI1.0D, UI1.2D); no court, hall, or speaker gains System-executed power (CAL0 SOC1.2D), no eligibility-by-category belief is promoted to fact (CAL0 WLD1.1D), and no new System mechanic, readout guarantee, or CAL0 change is created.

The series contract's WLD-PRENATAL-001A guardrail is respected as a read-only constraint: no ordinary prenatal practice of any effect is established, and no reincarnate or otherwise exceptional individual is established, mentioned, or implied; no WLD-SOUL default is adopted.
The parked sapient pack species remains parked and gains no development, and returning non-human peoples and other surviving human communities gain no development here.
story_implications: Later scenes may use hall standing, court obligation, spoken precedent and its fallibility, the virtue-versus-virtue grind, hall marks, and divided imperial-period memory, but every particular hall, court, precedent, dispute, belief, and outcome requires its own evidence.

Refuge-duty gives the settlement's founding admissions a resonance inside this culture's own ethics; the founding claims themselves belong to canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/settlement-founding-fusion-blend and are neither established nor closed here.
The speaker class supplies fallible authority — authoritative in standing, arguable in fact — as standing texture, with no court sitting, precedent, or dispute established.
The locally-rooted strand class gains no fixed content and no strand becomes this culture; every strand class stays open as a protagonist origin.
A character knows precedent, another hall's custom, or the imperial-period past only through an available and fallible source.
system_implications: Ordinary setting extension: every faith, ancestor, and System-reading claim is a cultural layer — records, access, belief, interpretation, presentation — over unchanged natural System behaviour (CAL0 UI1.0D, UI1.2D).

The never-misremembering reading of the System is folk interpretation and often wrong; no System channel bears on testimony or recollection, attests truth, verifies precedent, or serves as court evidence, and no readout is guaranteed.

No court, hall, or speaker gains System-executed power (CAL0 SOC1.2D), no eligibility-by-category belief becomes fact (CAL0 WLD1.1D), rite content and natural-law awakening are untouched (CAL0 WLD1.0D unapplied), and ancestor and death belief settles no cosmology or Soul question (CAL0 RES0.10D).
No CAL0 change, new System mechanic, readout guarantee, rite effect, or project-default adoption is created.
research_questions: What in-world names, titles, and speech content belong to this culture, and what does its speech variety actually contain (protected unknowns; the language sibling owns them)?
What lifecycle-rite content does this culture carry, and how does it express the faith orientation (the rites sibling owns it)?
How did its practices braid into the settlement strands, and does it have any outlet-settlement presence?
Which hall lines, districts, and variant traditions does the story show?
What is the truth behind divided imperial-period memories — co-option, protection, collaboration — and was there any actual discouragement of the heights?
Is original-culture and compact resonance ever asserted in-world, by whom, and how contested is it?
What faith content exists beyond orientation — observances, shrine and practitioner classes, doctrine — and how accurate is any of it?
What is the real versus believed efficacy of hall-held System lore, and who hoards what?
What dress, festival, store, and exchange content belongs to the present settlement, which remains WLD-CULTURE-001's open space?
